fm.title: Activity visualization
fm.description: Visualize the order and timing of messages, events, function calls, and state transitions during simulation (1 blocks)

rows.intent: Visualize the order and timing of messages, events, function calls, and state transitions exchanged during simulation — use to debug interaction and sequencing behavior in message-based, Stateflow, or test-sequence models.

fm.title: Observers
fm.description: Non-intrusive monitoring and verification of a system under test through a separate observer model (2 blocks)

rows.intent: Reference a separate observer model to monitor and verify signals inside a system under test without editing the design — use when you want verification logic kept isolated from the model under test and reusable across harnesses.

Tap a signal from the system under test by its path and bring it into an observer for assessment — use inside an observer to pick exactly which internal signals to watch without adding ports to the design model.

fm.title: Test harness internals
fm.description: Primitive elements that implement the Test Sequence and Test Assessment blocks; not normally placed on their own (8 blocks)

rows.intent: Split a combined signal into its component lines — an internal routing primitive inside the Test Sequence and Test Assessment blocks; add the parent Test Sequence or Test Assessment block rather than placing this element directly.
Provide a grounded zero-valued input to leave a port intentionally undriven — an internal primitive inside the Test Sequence and Test Assessment blocks; not placed on its own in normal workflows.

The core S-Function engine inside the Test Sequence and Test Assessment blocks that executes the authored step-and-transition table to drive time- and state-based test stimulus and evaluate verify/assessment statements — use it by adding a Test Sequence or Test Assessment block, not this element directly.
Cap an unused output so it raises no unconnected-line warning — an internal primitive inside the Test Sequence and Test Assessment blocks; not placed independently in normal workflows.
